metadata.description: Public marketplace for Claude Code plugins and MCP clients from CE Dot Net

plugins.name: ace
plugins.description: Code Engine ACE - Intelligent pattern learning with continuous auto-search for Claude Code. Learns from your coding sessions and automatically surfaces relevant strategies, code snippets, APIs, and pitfalls as you work. v8.1.4. Requires: Claude Code >= 2.1.311, ace-cli >= 4.4.2 (pinned in package.json; @ace-sdk/core >= 3.8.2), Python >= 3.10 for the fallback hooks. Windows not supported (WSL2 works). Full changelog: https://github.com/ce-dot-net/ce-ai-ace/releases
